lines.t: I offer myself to you, my Lord
And my God, take my life, it's yours
You offered yourself up to suffering and death
On account of what I have done
You bore my sins on a tree
Even the sins of those I love
But by any and all means
I shall strive to show you my love and my gratitude
I leave my heart open to you
Mold it, create in me a pure heart
For I long to see your face
Renew in me your right spirit
That I may be steadfast for your purpose and walk in your way.
